# ZothOS-Lite v1.2 — Tails-Style Amnesic Monotone Linux OS (Debian 13 Live · RAM-Only)

> Ultra-lightweight amnesic RAM-only Linux operating system (`toram noswap`) designed strictly in Paper Ivory (`#F7F7F4`) and Pure Black Ink (`#000000`) with 2px solid borders, Ordered Bayer 8x8 dither, and Unicode `U+2800` Braille. Pre-configured for 56 curated AI models across 8 cloud & LAN providers, volatile RAM key isolation, first-boot onboarding (`zoth-lite-welcome`), ZothNet encrypted P2P mesh (`:8102`), and intentional external USB/NVMe & cloud persistence (`zoth-lite-storage`).

## Core OS Specifications
- **Canonical Website**: https://zothos-lite.nullai.tech
- **Source & ISO Builder**: https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zothos-lite | https://github.com/NullAITech/zothos-lite
- **OS Base & Kernel**: Debian 13 Trixie Live · Linux 6.12 amd64 (`boot=live components toram noswap slab_nomerge init_on_free=1`)
- **Design System**: Tails-style Amnesic Monotone (`#F7F7F4` Paper Ivory, `#000000` Black Ink, `SWCursor` X11 hardware-agnostic visibility, Unicode `U+2800` Braille TUI)
- **Thermal Guardrail**: Server-enforced CPU thermal ceiling (`80°C` throttle / `85°C` pause)
- **License & Access**: 100% Free & Open-Access (MIT, Zero Paywalls)
- **Architect**: 1nc0gn30 (`@1nc0gn30`) • NullAI Platform (`https://nullai.tech`)

## 56 Curated AI Models Across 8 Providers (`zoth-lite-models`)
Keys are stored strictly in volatile RAM (`/run/user/$UID/zoth-keys.env` or `/dev/shm`, `0600` permissions) and vanish automatically on shutdown/reboot unless exported explicitly.
1. **Ollama Local (`ollama`, 10 models)**: `qwen2.5-coder:7b` (Recommended Local), `qwen2.5-coder:32b`, `deepseek-r1:8b`, `deepseek-r1:14b`, `hermes3:8b`, `hermes3:70b`, `llama3.3:70b`, `llama3.2:3b`, `mistral-small:24b`, `phi4:14b`
2. **Hermes / Nous Research (`hermes`, 5 models)**: `deepseek-flash` (Recommended Lightweight Cloud Path via Hermes Agent by Nous Research), `hermes-4-405b`, `hermes-3-llama-3.1-405b`, `hermes-3-llama-3.1-70b`, `hermes-3-llama-3.1-8b`
3. **DeepSeek (`deepseek`, 4 models)**: `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-chat`, `deepseek-reasoner`, `deepseek-coder`
4. **OpenRouter (`openrouter`, 11 models)**: `deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3-0324`, `deepseek/deepseek-r1`, `nousresearch/hermes-3-llama-3.1-405b`, `nousresearch/hermes-3-llama-3.1-70b`, `anthropic/claude-3.7-sonnet`, `anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`, `openai/gpt-4o`, `openai/o3-mini`, `meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct`, `qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct`, `google/gemini-2.0-flash-001`
5. **OpenAI (`openai`, 7 models)**: `gpt-4.1`, `gpt-4.1-mini`, `gpt-4o`, `gpt-4o-mini`, `o3`, `o4-mini`, `o3-mini`
6. **Anthropic (`anthropic`, 6 models)**: `claude-sonnet-4-20250514`, `claude-opus-4-20250514`, `claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219`, `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022`, `claude-3-5-haiku-20241022`, `claude-3-opus-20240229`
7. **Google Gemini (`gemini`, 6 models)**: `gemini-2.5-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash`, `gemini-2.0-flash`, `gemini-2.0-flash-lite`, `gemini-1.5-pro`, `gemini-1.5-flash`
8. **Groq LPU (`groq`, 7 models)**: `llama-3.3-70b-versatile`, `llama-3.1-8b-instant`, `deepseek-r1-distill-llama-70b`, `qwen-qwq-32b`, `qwen-2.5-coder-32b`, `gemma2-9b-it`, `mixtral-8x7b-32768`

## Built-In OS CLI & Browser Workstation Utilities
- `zoth-lite-welcome`: Interactive 5-step first-boot onboarding & hardware tier recommender
- `zoth-lite-models`: 56-model / 8-provider router & volatile RAM key enclave CLI
- `zoth-lite-storage`: External USB/NVMe safe mounter (`/mnt/zoth-ext`) & SHA-256 / `rclone` cloud sync
- `zoth-lite-pkg`: Modular on-demand RAM OverlayFS package, `.deb`, and `.AppImage` installer
- `zothnet`: Encrypted LAN (`:8102`), WireGuard, and Tor v3 Onion P2P peer discovery & chat
- `zothos-lite-tui`: Monotone Unicode `U+2800` Braille telemetry terminal
